note: Illinois DNR fish and wildlife area near Chandlerville. Prairie Lake Campground fills a wooded peninsula on 210-acre Prairie Lake (no-wake, boats allowed); nine rent-a-cabins line its shore. Horses use the separate Questing Hills equestrian campground about 7 km north-west. Mountain-bike and hiking trails circle the lake. --Claude
